nodes.title: START HERE — YuE2 Quick Starter Instructions
widgets_values:
YuE2 Quick Song Starters 🎵

First use only: Missing foundation models (YuE2-3B and YuE2-Vae) automatically download from Hugging Face into ComfyUI/models/yue2 and ComfyUI/models/vae upon first queue. No manual setup or downloads required.

Quick Start (2 Modes)

  1. Preset Mode (Default): Select any of the curated presets in YuE2 Quick Song Starters (e.g. K-Pop Fusion, 80s Synthwave, Piano Pop, Lo-Fi Chillhop). It automatically outputs cohesive style tags, sectioned lyrics, and matching BPM into the generator.
  2. Direct / Manual Mode (Bypassing Preset):
    • To write your own style and lyrics directly: select YuE2 Quick Song Starters and press Ctrl+M to bypass it (or disconnect the style, lyrics, and cot wires from the generator).
    • Type your custom style description directly into the style box and your lyrics directly into the lyrics box inside YuE2 Neural Song Generator.

Useful Settings & Optimizations

  • keep_model_loaded: True (default) keeps the model loaded in GPU VRAM between generations, making repeat runs instantaneous (saves 10–15s every run!). Set to False if you want to immediately free VRAM after each run.
  • ode_steps: 32 is reference studio fidelity; 24 is 1.3x faster (~3.5s saved); 16 is ultra-fast draft mode (~2x faster).
  • attention_backend: auto / cudnn is fastest on RTX 40/50 series GPUs; sage uses SageAttention INT8 QK; sdpa is standard PyTorch.
  • cot: full enables Chain-of-Thought musical planning (melody tokens + audio synthesis).
  • seed: 0 generates a random seed on each queue. Use the dropdown below it to set randomize, increment, decrement, or fixed.

Audio Output: Preview the generated song directly in the graph or find the saved copy in ComfyUI/output/YuE2 (MP3 320k, WAV, or FLAC). Hover over any parameter for detailed tooltips.
